hero.headline: Orchestrate AI Agents Directly Inside Your GitHub Workflow
hero.subheadline: GitOrch is the ultimate control plane for software engineering automation. Connect your account and put autonomous agents to manage, test, and document demands directly in your Issues and Projects V2. No platform switch, zero friction.
hero.microcopy: 1-click install via GitHub App. No bureaucracy.

items.title: Native & Invisible Synchronization
items.benefit: Your agents work where your team already is. They manage sub-issues, update timelines, and move cards in Projects V2 automatically.

items.title: Zero Code Hallucinations
items.benefit: The engine maps your entire architecture, dependencies, and repo impact before acting. Agents decide based on facts, not guesses.

items.title: Long-Term Coordination & Memory
items.benefit: Agents talk to each other and remember context from past deliveries. Less rework, more autonomy for complex end-to-end tasks.

items.title: Unified Control Plane
items.benefit: Real-time dashboard (Mission Control) via SSE. Full visibility into what agents are doing, logs, metrics, health.
